newsitem.title: USA: U.S. LAYOFFS 48,349 JULY VS 15,091 JUNE - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: U.S. LAYOFFS 48,349 JULY VS 15,091 JUNE - REPORT.

text.p: U.S. layoffs totaled 48,349 in July, the largest job-cut month since March 1997, according to a report by Challenger, Gray & Christmas Inc.
The July headline figure shot up more than three times in June and represents a 15.5 percent increase over the 41,843 layoffs announced in July 1996, it said.
About 50,182 job cuts were announced in March 1997.

"The fact that significant job cuts can occur in the midst of the biggest hiring boom in a generation is clear-cut evidence that downsizing has become an enduring tool of business," said John Challenger, executive vice president of Challenger, Gray & Christmas.
